basics.summary: Computer Science undergraduate with practical experience in distributed backend systems, REST APIs, and modern cloud deployment pipelines.

highlights: Engineered idempotency middleware in Go for merchant webhook dispatches, processing 25,000+ daily events.
Reduced duplicate event retries by 42% through distributed Redis lock keying.
Collaborated with the core payments team to write unit and contract tests achieving 94% test coverage.

projects.name: IndicDoc - Multilingual RAG Document Assistant
projects.tagline: Retrieval-augmented Q&A pipeline over vernacular enterprise documents in 8 Indian languages
projects.description: Developed a multilingual document question-answering platform that indexes enterprise PDFs and answers queries in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada with source citation.
highlights: Implemented hybrid vector search combining BM25 and multilingual embeddings using ChromaDB.
Integrated Sarvam AI and Gemini models to handle low-resource Indian language queries accurately.
Optimized chunking and reranking pipeline, cutting hallucinated citations by 38%.

projects.name: ChronoQueue - Distributed Fault-Tolerant Task Orchestrator
projects.tagline: Lightweight distributed job queue in Go with exponential backoff and dead-letter queues
projects.description: Architected a high-throughput distributed task scheduler designed to manage asynchronous background jobs across multiple worker nodes with guaranteed at-least-once delivery.
highlights: Designed raft-based leader election and persistent write-ahead logging (WAL) for task state durability.
Built worker node heartbeat health checks and automated failover recovery mechanisms.
Constructed a real-time monitoring dashboard using WebSockets and Prometheus metrics.
metrics: Zero data loss under abrupt worker shutdown

projects.name: SafePay - Real-Time UPI Transaction Anomaly Detector
projects.tagline: Sub-50ms fraud scoring engine analyzing transaction patterns and device telemetry
projects.description: Engineered an anomaly detection microservice evaluating streaming UPI payments against velocity rules and behavioral risk models to prevent unauthorized transfers.
highlights: Developed sliding-window event aggregation using Redis Streams and Python.
Trained an isolation forest classifier on synthetic transactional patterns detecting geographic jumps.
Exposed gRPC and REST endpoints with automated token verification and rate limiting.
